content.title: Family First: CEOs' Private Incentives in Corporate Relocations
content.abstract: Using novel data on executives’ families, we identify CEOs’ private motives in moving corporate headquarters (HQ). CEOs systematically relocate HQs closer to their families over plausible location alternatives. Over 35% of relocations place the new HQ within 50 miles of the CEO’s children and away from production sites and industry clusters. Such relocations entail negative announcement returns, higher employee turnover, and weaker insider reviews.
